about: Labelled seller replies for the seller-messages check, all about the same honest-looking ad (a 2017 Honda Accord EX-L, $9,000, 98,000 miles, clean title, no accidents, private seller). 'scam': true means the reply shows a known scam pattern a buyer should stop at. Written before the first measurement (2026-11-10), from FTC/FBI/NICB patterns; honest replies reuse the same words innocently.
ad:
2017 Honda Accord EX-L $9,000
98,000 miles, clean title, no accidents
Private seller in Princeton. VIN 1HGCR2F8XHA000123
